metadata.description: AI writing skills for writers, editors, and anyone who writes for work. Revise drafts in your own voice, develop fictional characters, and get feedback on scenes.

plugins.name: humanized
plugins.description: Draft, edit, and review natural-sounding text for its audience and genre. Replace filler with concrete language, preserve the author’s voice and facts, and get specific feedback without rewriting.

plugins.name: character
plugins.description: Develop fictional characters and test how they act and speak in a scene that fits the book.
